I recently had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Castle, and I must say, it exceeded all my expectations. From the moment I arrived, the staff went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction. Their professionalism and warm hospitality truly set this hotel apart.

The rooms were impeccably clean, spacious, and elegantly furnished, offering all the amenities needed for a relaxing stay. The attention to detail was evident in everything—from the plush bedding to the thoughtful touches like complimentary refreshments and toiletries.

One of the highlights of my stay was the dining experience. The on-site restaurant served a variety of delicious dishes, each prepared with great care and presented beautifully. The breakfast buffet, in particular, was a treat, offering a wide range of options to suit every palate.

The hotel's location was perfect for exploring the area, and the staff were always ready to provide recommendations and assist with any queries. Whether it was arranging transportation or offering tips for local attractions, their support made my stay all the more enjoyable.

Overall, Hotel Castle is a shining example of excellent service and hospitality. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and memorable stay. I look forward to returning in the future!

This hotel needs a major overhaul.

The hotel is still in the 90’s,

1) Still using window ac which barely functions…
2) The fan does not switch off the regulator switch does nothing.
3) The geyser is there for show on the wall.
4) The room lock was broken it locks only from inside and in case the guest wishes to go out for a day then it won’t lock from outside with the physical key provided.
5) Sink tap was broken
6) Shower was not working, so the only way to have bath is with a plastic bucket & mug, and either sit on the plastic stool given or the floor.

The room service was OK, although staff was very good and helpful.

Hope the management reads this review and makes some welcome changes….
